title: Siang project strategic necessity due to China's mega dam plan: Arunachal CM amid protests

ai.summary: Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Pema Khandu described the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project as strategic for India's water security and defence, citing China's reported plan to build a 60,000-mw hydropower project on the Yarlung Tsangpo river. Protests against the project have seen violence including property damage, prompting security deployments.

facts.quote: Siang project strategic necessity due to China's mega dam plan: Arunachal CM amid protests

facts.claim: China's reported plan to construct a 60,000-mw hydropower project on the Yarlung Tsangpo river
facts.quote: China's reported plan to construct a 60,000-mw hydropower project on the river has raised concerns over the possibility of water storage or diversion and its potential impact on downstream areas

facts.claim: SUMP would have a storage capacity of around 9.2 billion cubic metres
facts.quote: SUMP would have a storage capacity of around 9.2 billion cubic metres , compared with the reported 5.2 BCM capacity of the Chinese project

facts.claim: protests against the project have seen violence including property damage
facts.quote: Protests against the proposed project in the Siang region have witnessed incidents of violence, including damage to public and private property

ai.background_note: The Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum opposes the proposed mega dam on the Siang in Arunachal Pradesh, after a month of detentions, the state freed four protesters on 7 November.
